headlines.description: — Jason Zucker broke a tie on a power play at 5:31 of the third period and he Buffalo Sabres beat the two-time defending Stanley Cup champion Florida Panthers 5-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jason Zucker breaks 3rd-period tie in the Sabres' 5-3 win over the Panthers

headlines.description: — Claude Giroux scored with just over five minutes remaining in the third period and the Ottawa Senators beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 3-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giroux's goal with just over five minutes remaining lifts Senators past Penguins 3-2

events.name: New York Islanders at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Martin Fehervary and Anthony Beauvillier scored 31 seconds apart in the second period, and the Washington Capitals beat the New York Islanders 4-1 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Capitals top Islanders 4-1 to pull within 2 points of 3rd place in the Metropolitan Division

headlines.description: — Kirill Kaprizov scored his second goal of the game on a power play at 3:38 of overtime to give the Minnesota Wild a 4-3 victory over the Montreal Canadiens on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaprizov scores 2nd goal of game on a power play in OT to lift Wild past Canadiens, 4-3

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Nashville Predators

headlines.description: — Steven Stamkos scored twice in the third period to help the Nashville Predators rally for a 6-5 victory over the St. Louis Blues on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stamkos scores twice in 3rd in Predators' 6-5 comeback win over Blues

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Ryan Donato had two goals and two assists, and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the San Jose Sharks 6-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan Donato scores twice as the Blackhawks beat the Sharks 6-3

headlines.description: — Thomas Harley scored at 2:05 of overtime, and the Dallas Stars matched their longest winning streak of the season at five games with a 4-3 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas Harley scores in OT as Stars beat Jets 4-3 for 5th straight win

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Colorado Avalanche

headlines.description: — John Gibson stopped 21 shots for his fourth shutout of the season and Lucas Raymond scored and had his team-leading 41st assist as the Detroit Red Wings beat the Colorado Avalanche 2-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gibson and Raymond power Red Wings to a 2-0 victory over the Avalanche

headlines.description: — Nick Schmaltz had his second hat trick of the season and added two assists for a five-point game in the Utah Mammoth's 6-2 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nick Schmaltz has hat trick in 5-point game, Mammoth beat Canucks 6-2

events.name: Toronto Maple Leafs at Calgary Flames

headlines.description: — William Nylander scored on a breakaway 35 seconds into the game and added two assists that helped the Toronto Maple Leafs beat the Calgary Flames 4-2 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nylander leads the Maple Leafs to a 4-2 win over the Flames
